# EntryList

The browsable name list.

`LL.EntryList` · Components · Lists & labels

## Use

```jsx
<LL.EntryList items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.EntryList" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (EntryListProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `EntryListItem[]` |  |
| `activeId` | `string` |  |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `fade` | `boolean` | Fade the top and bottom edges. Default true. Give the list a height; it scrolls. |
| `density` | `'comfortable' \| 'standard' \| 'compact'` | comfortable and standard: 24px names on 48 or 40px rows; compact: 17px names (name-row) on 32px rows. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
